_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: types $24-$26 ($8E68-$9079). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): first frame?
regions.description: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): bit 7 set goes to `$8E9F`. Stats: hit points 12, 16, 20 (x 16 once widened), attack 16, 36, 80, collision flags `$5A`, drawing flags 0, art block `$2A`, dies as type 7.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): per-type values
TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): art wait, hit points
TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): set-up
regions.description: The phase `$07B8` := 0, metasprite `$6D`, a random x (`$C0F0`), y := `$28` (40), `$0788` := `$3C` (60 frames of introduction), `JSR $C0A2`.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): the introduction
regions.description: While `$0788` counts down the boss is drawn only on every second frame (it flickers) and cannot be hit.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): walk toward the player
regions.description: On every second frame (`$41` bit 0 clear) `JSR $A325`: x moves one pixel toward the player's x. RUN: x 142 -> 162 in 40 frames.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): the claw cycle
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` with step `$07A0` and a limit of 60: the counter `$0638` runs 0-59 (a faster counter for the later types).

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): draw the body
regions.description: `JSR $C090` (draw without moving; the boss does not move except by the x creep above).

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): hit points still above 255?
regions.description: `$0740` (the high part) non-zero skips the phase logic: the phases only start once the hit points are below 256.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): to the claws
TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): which phase
regions.description: `$07B8`: 0 -> `$8F41`, 1 -> `$8EEF`, 2 or more continues.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): phase 2 and later
regions.description: `$0638` of `$1E` or more wraps to `$14`; hit points under `$32` set palette 1 (the damaged look); on to `$8FAA`. RUN: the counter ran 17 -> 31 -> 23 -> 27 -> 21 through the fight.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): phase 1: lose the arms
regions.description: `$86` := 1 (the flip byte for the pieces). While the hit points `$0590` are `$14` (20) or more, nothing happens (`$8F50`).

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): phase 1: two slots for the arms
regions.description: Two free slots are taken (the first marked type 5 as a reservation); if the second is missing the first is given back and the hit points are set to `$14` to try again.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): phase 1: the arms leave
regions.description: `JSR $903A` creates an arm (type `$AC`) in each slot, at the left piece's x (`$0680`, palette 1) and the right piece's x (`$0668`, palette `$41`, flipped); the boss's hit points := `$C8` (200) and the phase goes to 2. RUN: two type-`$AC` objects at y 96 (boss y + 56) appeared at frame 300, x 255 and 220.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): phase 0: first bar gone
regions.description: Hit points under `$14` (20): `$0590` := `$64` (100) and the phase becomes 1. RUN: hit points 19 at frame 150 gave phase 1 and 100.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): how far the claws are spread
regions.description: `$15` from the counter `$0638`: under 10 = 0 (closed); 10-25 = counter - 10 (opening); 26-33 = `$10` (open); 34-49 = `$33` - counter (closing); 50 or more = 0. The claws open and close in a 50-step cycle.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): the left claw
regions.description: A piece 56 px below the body (`$84` + `$38`), x = the body's x - 8 - spread (stored in `$0680`), metasprite `$6E` (110) through `$C093`; skipped when the x would wrap.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): the right claw
regions.description: x = the body's x + 8 + spread (stored in `$0668`), the flip byte `$86` toggled (a mirrored copy), metasprite `$6E`. RUN: the two pieces' x were 8 + spread either side of the body.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): introduction: no attacks
regions.description: `$0788` non-zero returns.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): the beam moment
TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): beam set-up
regions.description: `$17` := tile base + `$1E`, `$16` := `$10` (the beam's y speed).

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): fire the beam
regions.description: A free slot (`$C027`), `$0638` advanced past `$1C`, the beam's style record `$FE22 + $12` (metasprite `$1A`, `$0638` `$F0`, half-width 8), drawing flags 3, palette 0, a child of the boss through `$C13E` (type `$22`), y := the boss's + `$18`, and the boss's attack `$05A8`. RUN: beams (type `$22`) at y 64 every 72 frames in phase 2.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): when the claws shoot
regions.description: Only while `$0638` is under `$1A` and a multiple of 8.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): the bullets
regions.description: If the animation fraction `$0650` is under `$07D0` (1, 1, 5 by type) and a slot is free: a type-`$27` bullet (`$C105`) with direction `$0788` := a random bit x 8 (0 = right, 8 = left) and `$07A0` := `$07D0`. RUN: bullets at directions 0 and 8, in phases 0 and 1 and in phase 2.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): the hit box
regions.description: `JSR $C0B1` (the box from the metasprite); in phases 0 and 1 its bottom edge `$0728` is extended downward by `$40` (64 px), so the claws can be hit.

regions.name: TYPES $24 / $25 / $26 (CLAWBOT, corridor bosses 14, 15 and 20): hit test
regions.description: `JSR $C0C9` (`$D297`, mask `$30`), `JMP $C0D8` (`$D39B`, the boss's resolution).

regions.name: Clawbot palette by type
Clawbot animation step by type
Clawbot bullet limit by type
Clawbot: create an arm
regions.description: Y = a slot: type `$AC` (type `$2C`, initialised), y := the boss's + `$38`, metasprite `$6E`, the boss's tile base, collision flags `$52`, drawing flags `$11`, `$07B8` := `$2A` (the art block), `$07D0` := `$0B`, attack `$80`, hit points `$FF`, velocity cleared (`$C147`), y speed fraction `$05C0` := `$30`. The arm is then driven by type `$2C`'s own handler (`$9742`).
